tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search for a book across every bookseller Near Fine covers for the buyer's country, ebook and audiobook stores included; list_sources names them. Shops' ebooks and audiobook downloads are offered only in their own country. Pass an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 for an exact edition, or title and author keywords

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the bookseller catalogs Near Fine searches, each with the countries it serves. Pass a country to see only the sources that serve buyers there.

tools.name: set_alert
tools.description: Set an alert on a search for the person. The first time, they sign in to Near Fine. Near Fine checks the alert for six months and emails them when a new listing turns up with everything the query asks for, such as a first edition, a signed copy or a price cap. tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the person's alerts on Near Fine. The first time, they sign in. Finds come first, then alerts being checked, then the rest, newest first. tools.name: cancel_alert
tools.description: Cancel one of the person's alerts on Near Fine by its id, from list_alerts or set_alert, deleting it as its Delete button on Near Fine does. The first time, they sign in. Returns the cancelled alert and the person's plan.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_books, set_alert, list_alerts · Public sink: search_books, set_alert · Destructive: cancel_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_books, set_alert, list_alerts · Public sink: search_books, set_alert · Destructive: cancel_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_books" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search for a book across every bookseller Near Fine covers for the buyer's country (AbeBooks and eBay sites everywhere, plus World of Books, ThriftBooks, Better World Books, Books-A-Million, Casa del Libro, Hugendubel, preigu, Booklooker, Leslibraires.fr, Rarewaves, Ex Libris, Librairie Mollat, Boek" → after: "Search for a book across every bookseller Near Fine covers for the buyer's country, ebook and audiobook stores included; list_sources names them. Shops' ebooks and audiobook downloads are offered only in their own country. Pass an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 for an exact edition, or title and author keywords"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
